label: Uganda gorillas + chimps
summary: LAX→Istanbul (1 night)→Entebbe late Dec 21. Fly to Bwindi gorillas, Christmas in QENP, Kibale chimps, fly Kasese→EBB→Nairobi Dec 27/28. ~+$3,900 pp. US advisory Level 4.
verdict: Best wildlife stopover: gorillas, chimps, tree-climbing lions, Kazinga hippos in 9 days, ~+$3,900 pp. Deal-breaker: still Level 4 (Jun 4 2026, Ebola) despite outbreak over — book refundable only until Level 3.

safety.advisory_level: Level 4 – Do Not Travel. Issued Jun 4 2026: crime, Ebola, terrorism, unrest; limited US consular services. Was Level 3 (Dec 8 2025). Not lowered as of Oct 8 2026 despite outbreak declared over (Uganda Jul 28, WHO Aug 26). Re-check travel.state.gov before paying.
safety.summary: Ebola over, but DRC transmission may continue; Bwindi/Ishasha border DRC, one imported case could close parks. ADF (ISIS-linked) killed honeymoon couple + guide in QENP Oct 2023; armed escorts since, no tourist attacks. 2023 Anti-Homosexuality Act applies to visitors; roads deadliest daily risk; real problem is insurance/refunds.
precautions: No non-refundable deposits (permits, Aerolink) at Level 4; get insurer coverage in writing
Enroll STEP; follow US Embassy Kampala alerts (DRC Ebola, ADF)
Licensed UWA operator + driver-guide only. No self-drive, boda-bodas, or driving after ~17:30
QENP: main circuits only; ranger escort in Ishasha when advised; get Kasese/Katwe security brief
LGBTQ: real legal risk; same-sex couples consider Rwanda; no public affection
Yellow fever vaccine required. Malaria pills, DEET, bottled water
Cold/flu symptoms can bar gorilla trek. Mask if asked, keep 7 m away

visa: US: Uganda single-entry eVisa $50 pp (visas.immigration.go.ug); apply 2+ wks ahead, print approval. East Africa Tourist Visa ($100) costs more than eVisa + base Kenya eTA. Passport 6+ months; yellow fever cert required. Istanbul: airside YOTEL needs no Turkish entry; landside OK, US visa-free (verify).
weather_dec: Short dry season starts (Dec–Feb). Bwindi muddy, afternoon showers, ~20–24°C day / 10–13°C night (1,500–2,300 m): rain jacket, gaiters. QENP/Kibale ~25–28°C, occasional showers. Festive peak: permits, lodges sell out.
highlights: Bwindi (Buhoma) gorilla trek: 1h with habituated family, ~95%+ success
Kibale chimp tracking: East Africa's densest primates, ~90% success
Ishasha tree-climbing lions on Christmas Eve
Christmas: Kasenyi game drive + Kazinga boat (hippos, buffalo, elephants, birds)
Aerolink light aircraft over green hills; skips 9–10h drives
Bigodi Wetland community walk: red colobus, turacos
drawbacks: Level 4 still shown (Jun 4 2026, Ebola); ADF history in QENP; Anti-Homosexuality Act
No same-night link: TK10 lands IST ~19:00, IST→EBB departs ~15:20–15:40; IST night, EBB ~22:00 Dec 21
No Uganda rest day; IST night + slow Dec 22 morning instead; Nairobi rest Dec 28
Aerolink: no 2026 timetable (2023: Flt 121 EBB 12:30), minimum pax, no KQ connection; late Kasese → KQ419 00:10
Christmas permits limited (8/family/day). Book Buhoma Dec 23 now or Rushaga/Ruhija; paid in full via operator
UWA Jul 2026+ tariff unpublished; permits reportedly flat to Jan 1 2027 (chimps → $300); confirm
Rwanda alt: $1,500 permit, 2.5h from Kigali, no flights; similar/higher cost, less wildlife

legs.detail: TK10 LAX 19:45 → IST 19:00 (+1), winter schedule from Oct 24 (flightmapper). TK multi-city LAX→EBB / NBO→LAX.
After IST hotel night: TK591 nonstop ~15:20 → EBB ~22:00 (Aug 2026 tracker; confirm). Avoid TK606 via Kigali (~15:40, lands ~01:00). No same-night link from TK10.
Aerolink Flt 121 EBB 12:30 → Kihihi ~14:00 (2023 schedule; confirm). ~$378 one way. 15 kg soft bag.
Driver-guide (vehicle pre-positioned from Kampala) drives to Buhoma, ~15:30.
Buhoma→Ishasha dirt road, then 1.5–2h lion game drive.
Ishasha→Katunguru/Mweya through park, before dark. Day ~4.5–5h road.
Mweya→Kanyanchu via crater lakes, mostly paved. Chimps 14:00.
Aerolink Kasese/Mweya→EBB, early–mid afternoon (2026 trackers: Kihihi–EBB ~15:50). Unconfirmed: EBB–Kasese maybe only from Nov 2026. Fallback: Mweya strip.
Separate ticket. KQ417 ~17:50–18:05 if Aerolink lands by ~15:30, else KQ419 00:10 → NBO 01:25 Dec 28 (Jul/Aug 2026). Both before 06:00 Dec 28. UR alt. ~$180–350.
Pre-booked taxi to Karen guesthouse (book Dec 27 night to hold room past midnight).

itinerary.title: Land IST, hotel
itinerary.details: Land 19:00. Airport hotel (YOTEL airside or nearby). Sleep.

itinerary.title: Fly to Uganda
itinerary.details: Slow morning. TK591 ~15:20, ~6.7h → EBB ~22:00. 15 min to guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Fly to Bwindi
itinerary.details: Sleep in. Aerolink 12:30, ~1.5h to Kihihi. 1.25h drive, Buhoma ~15:30. Pack for trek.

itinerary.title: Gorilla trek
itinerary.details: 07:30 briefing. 2–6h steep, muddy trek; 1h with gorillas. Porter $20.

itinerary.title: Tree-climbing lions
itinerary.details: ~2h to Ishasha. ~1.5h fig-tree game drive. ~2.5h to Mweya/Katunguru by 17:00. ~4.5–5h road, longest day.

itinerary.title: Christmas on Kazinga
itinerary.details: Dawn Kasenyi drive ~3h (lions, kob, elephants). Midday rest. 15:00 Kazinga boat 2h. <1h driving.

itinerary.title: Chimps
itinerary.details: ~2h via crater lakes. Chimps 14:00, 2–3h. Optional dawn Bigodi walk if flight allows.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kenya
itinerary.details: ~2h to Kasese strip. Aerolink ~1.5h to EBB. KQ417 ~18:00 (or KQ419 00:10, lands 01:25 Dec 28). 45 min taxi to Karen. 2h road. Dec 28 rest.

booking.task: Check travel.state.gov (Level 4 early Oct); get insurer's written Level 4 answer. Proceed only at Level 3 or accepted risk.
Via licensed UWA operator: check Buhoma gorillas Dec 23, Kibale chimps Dec 26 PM. Full payment, no holds.
Book TK multi-city LAX→EBB (TK10 Dec 19, TK591 Dec 21) / NBO→LAX instead of base RT. IST hotel Dec 20.
Confirm Aerolink Dec 22 EBB→Kihihi 12:30, Dec 27 Kasese→EBB. Then EBB→NBO: KQ417 if lands by 15:30, else KQ419 00:10.
Book 4x4 + driver (Dec 22–27); lodges: Entebbe, Buhoma, QENP, Kibale, Karen.
Travel clinic: yellow fever cert, malaria pills
Uganda eVisa ($50) + Kenya eTA. Print approvals, yellow fever card.
Re-check advisory, Ebola news. Reconfirm Aerolink times, 15 kg soft bag.

fatigue: Dec 19: ~13h flight. Dec 20: land 19:00, IST hotel, no road. Dec 21: 6.7h flight, 0.25h road. Dec 22: 0.25h road + 1.5h flight + 1.25h road, late start. Dec 23: no road, 2–6h trek. Dec 24: ~4.5–5h road incl. game drive (cap). Dec 25: <1h road. Dec 26: 2h road + chimps. Dec 27: 2h road + ~2.7h flights + 0.75h taxi; maybe after-midnight NBO. Dec 28: Nairobi rest. Road ≤~5h only via Aerolink. No Uganda rest day. Hard days: Dec 24, 27.
safety_short: Level 4 since Jun 2026 (Ebola; Uganda outbreak over, DRC ongoing). ADF killed tourists in QENP 2023, none since. Anti-LGBTQ law. Many insurers exclude Level 4.
